//: wet secrets map — 1Password. The middle segment of the filename is the
//provider: provider: wet.op.json is read by wet-secrets.sh (op), wet.az.json would be read by an az producer. Copy to the repo root and edit.
//vault: Defaults for bare field names below. Overridable with --vault/--item or OP_VAULT/OP_ITEM, so the committed file works against a personal vault locally and a shared one in CI.
//groups: Env key -> where the value lives. A bare name is a field on the default item; 'Item/field' names another item in the same vault; a full 'op://vault/item/field' overrides both. Name a group on the command line to act on that subset.
